body: Isolated diagnostic execution only; no production source changes. This clean branch descends from #405's exact-source relock 8ae0580b1567b18318413c1b4afcfc96390130a0, and retains the source-only one-call verifier. The production native SSE instrument was already released successfully from #1512, with source and application bytes verified. Once PR scope is assigned, a one-shot CI job with an exact activation commit guard will run just one pinned Gemini 3.8 synthetic canary via plaintext-h /api/khonapolit, preserve original SSE, independently compare upstream part text with TD613 returned text, and then be removed. Zero retries, zero fallbacks, zero real personal data. This is not a style restoration.
title: research(marrowline): one-shot raw Gemini SSE origin parity canary
